name: Fallon Gateway
summary: Modern shopping center with a variety of household-name retailers, services & several restaurants. Located in the heart of Dublin, this well-rated community destination serves the Tri-Valley area with convenient shopping and dining options.
demographics: Fallon Gateway attracts a diverse mix of families and professionals from Dublin and the surrounding Tri-Valley area, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income households. The trade area serves a well-educated demographic with many dual-income families, reflecting Dublin's status as one of the Bay Area's fastest-growing suburban communities. Shoppers typically range from young families with children to established professionals aged 25-55, drawn to the center's convenient location along Dublin Boulevard and its mix of everyday necessities and dining options.
description: Fallon Gateway stands as a prominent modern shopping destination in the heart of Dublin, California, serving the thriving Tri-Valley community with a carefully curated mix of household-name retailers, essential services, and diverse dining options. Located at 2820 Dublin Boulevard, this open-air community center has become a cornerstone of daily life for Dublin residents, offering convenient access to everything from grocery shopping to professional services. The center's contemporary design and well-maintained facilities create an inviting atmosphere for shoppers seeking both efficiency and comfort. With a strong 4.3-star rating from nearly 2,400 reviews, Fallon Gateway has earned its reputation as a reliable and popular shopping destination. The center's strategic location in one of the Bay Area's fastest-growing suburban markets positions it perfectly to serve the needs of Dublin's diverse and affluent population, making it an essential stop for both routine errands and leisurely shopping experiences.
